profile.headline: Founder at OmnisonrAI
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
For nearly 30 years I’ve worked on one hard problem: making customer experience work at scale. My foundation is deep in enterprise contact center engineering — Cisco UCCE, ICM, and CVP, and global routing architectures supporting environments from hundreds to tens of thousands of agents — and over the last decade I’ve carried that into cloud-native, AI-driven CX: large-scale CCaaS migrations, enterprise RBAC and governance frameworks, conversational AI, and multimillion-dollar gains through automation and platform simplification.
Most recently, I did something I’d spent my career wishing the big platforms would do: I designed and built one myself. KenetiCX is a production, multi-tenant, AI-native CCaaS platform — routing, a browser softphone, agent and supervisor desktops, quality and workforce management, billing, and a glass-box AI engine where every decision is explainable and a human stays in the loop. End to end, from the data model to the floor.
That’s the thread through everything I do: simplify legacy complexity, make systems observable and governable, and apply AI where it earns its place — practical innovation over technology for its own sake. I care as much about the agent’s experience as the customer’s, because the floor is where CX is actually won or lost.
I’m always glad to connect with CX and technology leaders, product teams, and organizations modernizing customer engagement.
Specialties: CCaaS architecture & modernization · AI & conversational automation (glass-box, human-in-the-loop) · Large-scale routing & journey orchestration · Workforce management & quality · Enterprise RBAC, security & governance · Cloud platform engineering, observability & SRE · Google CCAI/CCAIP · Dynamics 365, Power Platform & Copilot · Cisco UCCE, ICM & CVP · Product & engineering leadership

positions.title: Founder
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
COMPANY
• Founded OmnisonrAI and created its flagship product, KenetiCX, as sole founder and engineer, owning product development, architecture, brand, and go-to-market.
PLATFORM DEVELOPMENT
• Architected and built a production CCaaS platform across an Express/Prisma/PostgreSQL backend, React/Vite operations dashboard, and Next.js marketing site.
• Unified voice, chat, SMS, email, and WhatsApp with browser-based calling, queues, routing, operating hours, transfers, wrap-up, and an embedded chat widget.
• Developed Alloy HX, an AI engine combining knowledge assistance, routing intelligence, customer memory, sentiment analysis, and summaries, with explainable decisions and human approval of proposed changes.• Built workforce and quality management capabilities spanning Erlang-C forecasting, scheduling, historical data imports, scorecards, calibration, coaching, difficulty analysis, and root-cause investigation.
SECURITY & OPERATIONS
• Implemented tenant isolation with PostgreSQL row-level security, role-based access controls, and authentication through JWT, Microsoft Entra SSO, MFA, and passkeys/WebAuthn.
• Established seat-based Stripe billing, telemetry and alerting, retention controls, backup and recovery runbooks, load-testing baselines, and ongoing security hardening.
• Integrated Twilio, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Stripe, Postmark, and HubSpot, with infrastructure on Railway and Cloudflare and pipelines for continuous integration and database migrations.
BUSINESS & GO-TO-MARKET
• Developed the marketing site, pricing strategy, product documentation, CRM workflows, and status page.
• Prepared Terms, Privacy, DPA, and SLA drafts for legal review, alongside security and data-handling documentation to support customer due diligence.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
I lead the design and development of cloud‑native, AI‑powered customer experience platforms that shape how millions of customers and thousands of agents interact with T‑Mobile. My work spans architecture, secure workflow design, AI enablement, and large‑scale routing modernization — all focused on building intelligent, resilient experiences that foster customer love and loyalty.
Highlights
• 	Set platform direction for T‑Mobile’s CCaaS, Dynamics 365, and Google CCAIP ecosystems.
• 	Designed secure, compliant customer workflows through a Dynamics 365 RBAC + data governance framework.
• 	Led the migration of 10,000+ agents to a cloud routing architecture.
• 	Engineered conversational AI + model‑ops capabilities for virtual agents and intent models.
• 	Delivered multimillion‑dollar automation gains across the contact center ecosystem.
• 	Improved observability and platform resilience with proactive monitoring + diagnostics.
• 	Mentored engineers to elevate architectural thinking and development quality.

positions.description:

- Partnered across engineering, operations, and vendors to ensure seamless cutovers with minimal customer impact.
